denominator: All eligible weight in each age/sex domain, including unclassified records
limitations: Public cross-sectional observations cannot identify latent state or transition rates.
Adult, noninstitutionalized survey population and 2017-March 2020 period do not directly initialize every age of the 2024 engine population.
Public age top-coding prevents single-age decomposition in the oldest group; no pediatric interpolation is performed.
Known diagnoses retain precedence within complete cases; incomplete records can remain unclassified despite known diabetes.
Treatment use, control duration, diabetes type, all chronic diseases and confirmed remission are not identified.
PreChronic alternatives and overlapping age domains share observations and must not be summed.
No active model parameter or numerical engine output changes.

observation_state_mapping.population: U.S. noninstitutionalized adults in the positive-weight NHANES 2017-March 2020 fasting subsample, excluding known pregnancy within the public age window
observation_state_mapping.uncertainty: Existing Taylor logit-t pointwise survey intervals; shared observations, not independent draws. Missingness, diagnostic error, definition and transport uncertainty not identified.
observation_state_mapping.unit: fraction of eligible survey weight; unweighted records

risk.bp_rule: Mean of all three oscillometric readings; either mean at least threshold; one combined BP marker
risk.definition_status: Synthetic operational choices for structural comparison, not clinically validated PreChronic thresholds; individual marker cutoffs are sourced definitions
risk.diagnosis_rule: Yes to known hypertension, high cholesterol, CHF, CHD, angina, MI, stroke or cancer excludes candidate status; unknown responses excluded
risk.glycemic_definition: Inherit registered nhanes_glycemic_prevalence analysis; diabetes then prediabetes take priority
risk.triglyceride_rule: Strictly greater than threshold per cited NHLBI page
risk.waist_rule: Strictly greater than NHLBI 40/35 inches converted at exactly 2.54 cm/inch; not ethnicity-specific

uncertainty: Existing Taylor logit-t pointwise survey intervals; shared observations, not independent draws. Missingness, diagnostic error, definition and transport uncertainty not identified.
unit: fraction of eligible survey weight; unweighted records
